title: Constructible pro-étale coefficients are of étale origin
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\geq1$ and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $T$ be a scheme. Write
$\nu_T:T_{\Proet}\to T_{\Et}$ for the
comparison morphism of
sites [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $T_{\Proet}$ being the small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Call a sheaf of $A$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ constructible when it
satisfies the condition of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], and
call a sheaf of $A$-modules on $T_{\Proet}$ constructible when it
satisfies the intrinsic condition of
[def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: there is a finite disjoint
partition of $T$ into locally closed constructible subschemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] on each of
which the restriction is locally constant with finite $A$-module stalks.

1. **(i)** The pullback $\nu_T^*$ induces an equivalence of categories
between the constructible sheaves of $A$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ and the
constructible sheaves of $A$-modules on $T_{\Proet}$.
1. **(ii)** Consequently $\nu_T^*$ induces an equivalence between the
bounded complexes with constructible cohomology sheaves on the two sites: between the full subcategory $\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$ of $D(T_{\Et},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and the full subcategory of $D(T_{\Proet},A)$ of the complexes $K$ whose cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^q(K)$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] vanish for all but finitely many $q$ and are all constructible (the intrinsic bounded constructible pro-étale category).
In particular the two readings of the bounded constructible pro-étale
category — the intrinsic one just described and the one by étale
origin of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], recorded in clause (3) of
[lem-cbc-proetale-stalk-conservative] — agree: they have the same objects.

u_{T,*}

u_T^*G,

u_T^*$ is fully faithful on sheaves of $A$-modules, in particular on constructible ones. Call a sheaf $\mathcal F$ of $A$-modules on $T_{\Proet}$ *classical* if $\mathcal F\cong

proof.text:
*Step 3 (being classical is Zariski-local).* Let $v:V\hookrightarrow T$ be an open subscheme. The étale and pro-étale sites of $V$ are the localizations of those of $T$ at $V$, so $(
u_{T,*}\mathcal F)|_{V}=
u_{V,*}(\mathcal F|_V)$ (both have sections $\mathcal F(W)$ over an étale $W	o V$), and $v^{-1}
u_T^*\cong
u_V^*v^{-1}$ by [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]; under these identifications the restriction of $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}$ to $V$ is $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F|_V}$. Now let $T= igcup_aV_a$ be an open cover with every $\mathcal F|_{V_a}$ classical. By Step 2 every $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F|_{V_a}}$ is an isomorphism, i.e. the restriction of $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}$ to every member of the covering $\{V_a	o T\}$ of $T_{\Proet}$ is an isomorphism; by [lem-cbc-proetale-stalk-conservative] (1) $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}$ is an isomorphism, so $\mathcal F$ is classical by Step 2.

u_T^*G'\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal F\xrightarrow{b}
u_T^*G''\xrightarrow{\delta}(
u_T^*G')[1]$ in $D(T_{\Proet},A)$ (sheaves placed in degree $0$). Since $
u_T^*$ is exact on sheaves, it induces a triangulated functor $
u_T^*:D(T_{\Et},A)	o D(T_{\Proet},A)$ which commutes with shifts and with placing a sheaf in degree $0$ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. As $G''$ and $G'[1]$ lie in $\Dplus(T_{\Et},A)$, [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] gives a unique $\varphi:G''	o G'[1]$ with $
u_T^*(\varphi)=\delta$. By (TR1) choose a distinguished triangle $G''[-1]\xrightarrow{-\varphi[-1]}G'	o H	o G''$, and rotate it by (TR2) [def-weil-triangulated-category] to the distinguished triangle $G'	o H	o G''\xrightarrow{\varphi}G'[1]$. Its image $
u_T^*G'	o
u_T^*H	o
u_T^*G''\xrightarrow{\delta}(
u_T^*G')[1]$ is distinguished. Rotating both triangles so that they start with $
u_T^*G''\xrightarrow{\delta}(
u_T^*G')[1]$ and applying (TR3) to the pair $(\mathrm{id},\mathrm{id})$ gives a morphism of distinguished triangles whose first two components are identities; by [lem-sf-triangle-morphism-iso] its third component $(
u_T^*H)[1]	o\mathcal F[1]$ is an isomorphism, so $
u_T^*H\cong\mathcal F$ in $D(T_{\Proet},A)$. In the long exact cohomology sequence [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] of $G'	o H	o G''	o$ the outer terms vanish outside degree $0$, so $\mathcal H^q(H)=0$ for $q
eq0$ and $H\cong G[0]$ with $G=\mathcal H^0(H)$ [lem-sf-derived-concentrated-single]. Applying $\mathcal H^0$ to $
u_T^*(G[0])\cong
u_T^*H\cong\mathcal F[0]$ (an exact functor commutes with the cohomology of a complex) gives $
u_T^*G\cong\mathcal F$: $\mathcal F$ is classical.

proof.text:
*Step 5 (every constructible pro-étale sheaf is classical).* We prove by induction on $N\geq0$: for every scheme $Y$ and every sheaf $\mathcal F$ of $A$-modules on $Y_{\Proet}$ admitting a partition as in [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] with at most $N$ nonempty strata, $\mathcal F$ is classical. If $N=0$ then $Y=\emptyset$ and $\mathcal F=0=
u_Y^*0$. Let $N\geq1$, and let $Y= igsqcup_

u\cap V$, with the open subscheme structures of $Y_
u\cap V\subseteq Y_
u$, form a partition of $V$ by locally closed constructible subschemes, and $(\mathcal F|_V)|_{Y_
u\cap V}$ is the restriction of the locally constant sheaf $i_
u^*\mathcal F$ with finite stalks to an open subscheme of $Y_
u$ (inverse images compose [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]), hence again locally constant with finite stalks; so $\mathcal F_V:=\mathcal F|_V$ is constructible for this partition. Put $Z=Y_k\cap V$: it is closed in $V$, so the immersion $i:Z	o V$ is a closed immersion; its complement $j:U=V\setminus Z\hookrightarrow V$ is quasi-compact because $U$ is quasi-compact and $V$ is affine. u_U^*B$ for a sheaf $B$ on $U_{\Et}$, and $j_!j^*\mathcal F_V\cong j_!
u_U^*B\cong
u_V^*(j_!B)$ by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. (b) $i^*\mathcal F_V$ is locally constant with finite stalks on $Z_{\Proet}$, so $i^*\mathcal F_V\cong

proof.text:
*Step 6 (a sheaf whose pullback is constructible is constructible; proof of (i)).* Let $G$ be a sheaf of $A$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ such that $
u_T^*G$ is constructible, with partition $T= igsqcup_
u T_
u$, $i_
u:T_
u	o T$. For every $
u$, $
u_{T_
u}^*(i_
u^{-1}G)\cong i_
u^{-1}
u_T^*G$ [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] is locally constant with finite stalks, so by [lem-sf-proetale-locally-constant-origin] (b) it is isomorphic to $
u_{T_
u}^*H_
u$ with $H_
u$ lisse on $(T_
u)_{\Et}$, and by Step 2 on $T_
u$ the isomorphism $
u_{T_
u}^*(i_
u^{-1}G)\cong
u_{T_
u}^*H_
u$ is $
u_{T_
u}^*$ of an isomorphism $i_
u^{-1}G\cong H_
u$; so $i_
u^{-1}G$ is lisse and $G$ is constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Now (i): by Step 1, $
u_T^*$ carries constructible étale sheaves to constructible pro-étale sheaves; by Step 2 it is fully faithful on them; and every constructible $\mathcal F$ on $T_{\Proet}$ is $\cong
u_T^*G$ for some $G$ by Step 5, where $G$ is constructible by what was just shown. So $
u_T^*$ is an equivalence between the two categories of constructible sheaves of $A$-modules.

proof.text:
*Step 7 ((ii): $
u_T^*$ maps $\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$ fully faithfully into the intrinsic class).* Let $L\in\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$ with $\mathcal H^q(L)=0$ for $q
otin[a,b]$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. The functor $
u_T^*$ on $D(T_{\Et},A)$ is applied termwise [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated], and an exact functor commutes with the cohomology of a complex, so $\mathcal H^q(
u_T^*L)\cong
u_T^*\mathcal H^q(L)$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]; this vanishes for $q
otin[a,b]$ and is constructible for every $q$ by Step 1. So $
u_T^*L$ lies in the intrinsic class. Since $\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)\subset\Dplus(T_{\Et},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $
u_T^*$ is fully faithful on it by [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison].

source.place: Pro-etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 09AL (label lemma-compare-constructible-derived), first half; literature/bhatt-scholze-pro-etale-topology_arXiv-1309.1198.pdf, Proposition 5.2.6 (1), p. 37

proof.text:
*Step 8 ((ii): essential surjectivity, by induction on the amplitude).* Let $K\in D(T_{\Proet},A)$ have constructible cohomology sheaves vanishing outside $[a,b]$; we find $K'\in\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$ with $
u_T^*K'\cong K$, by induction on $b-a$ (if $K\cong0$ take $K'=0$). If $a=b$, then $K\cong\mathcal H^a(K)[-a]$ [lem-sf-derived-concentrated-single], and by (i) $\mathcal H^a(K)\cong
u_T^*F'$ with $F'$ constructible, so $K\cong
u_T^*(F'[-a])$ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. If $a<b$, take the truncation triangle $K_1	o K	o K_2\xrightarrow{\delta}K_1[1]$ of [lem-sf-derived-truncation-triangle] for $b$: $\mathcal H^q(K_1)=0$ for $q>b-1$ and $\mathcal H^q(K_2)=0$ for $q<b$, so by the long exact sequence [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] $\mathcal H^q(K_1)\cong\mathcal H^q(K)$ for $q\leq b-1$ and $\mathcal H^q(K_2)\cong\mathcal H^q(K)$ for $q\geq b$; thus $K_1$ has constructible cohomology in $[a,b-1]$ and $K_2$ has cohomology only in degree $b$. By induction $K_1\cong
u_T^*L'$ with $L'\in\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$, and by the case $a=b$, $K_2\cong
u_T^*M'$ with $M'=F'_b[-b]$. Transported along these isomorphisms, $\delta$ becomes a morphism $
u_T^*M'	o
u_T^*(L'[1])$, which by [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] is $
u_T^*(\varphi)$ for a unique $\varphi:M'	o L'[1]$ in $\Dplus(T_{\Et},A)$. As in Step 4, (TR1) and (TR2) [def-weil-triangulated-category] give a distinguished triangle $L'	o K'	o M'\xrightarrow{\varphi}L'[1]$; its image under the triangulated functor $
u_T^*$ [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] and the truncation triangle agree on the morphism $
u_T^*M'	o
u_T^*(L'[1])$, so after rotation (TR3) gives a morphism of distinguished triangles with two components isomorphisms, and [lem-sf-triangle-morphism-iso] gives $
u_T^*K'\cong K$. Finally $K'\in\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$: $
u_T^*\mathcal H^q(K')\cong\mathcal H^q(K)$ (Step 7), which is $0$ for $q
otin[a,b]$, whence $\mathcal H^q(K')\cong
u_{T,*}
u_T^*\mathcal H^q(K')=0$ [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level]; and is constructible for every $q$, whence $\mathcal H^q(K')$ is constructible by Step 6. This step uses only the étale side and the comparison, not that the intrinsic pro-étale class is triangulated.

source.place: Proposition 5.2.6 (3), p. 37 (the essential image of $\nu^*$ on $D^+$ consists of the complexes whose cohomology sheaves are classical; 'chasing triangles and truncations'), made explicit for bounded complexes; literature/stacks-project/proetale.tex, Lemma Tag 09AL

proof.text: *Step 9 (the two readings agree).* By [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] the étale-origin reading of the bounded constructible pro-étale category consists of the objects $K\in D(T_{\Proet},A)$ isomorphic to $\nu_T^*L$ for some $L\in\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$. By Step 7 every such object lies in the intrinsic class, and by Step 8 every object of the intrinsic class is of this form. So the two full subcategories of $D(T_{\Proet},A)$ have the same objects, and $\nu_T^*$ is an equivalence from $\Dbc(T_{\Et},A)$ onto either of them.

split_report.summary: The imported proof of (i) only quoted Stacks Tag 09AK and the proof of (ii) hid the triangulated-category steps. Rewrote the proof in 9 steps following Stacks Pro-etale Cohomology Lemmas 09AK and 09AL with the comparison inputs of Bhatt-Scholze §5.1, Prop. 5.2.6, Lemmas 6.1.11 and 6.2.3(4): preservation of constructibility, full faithfulness and the counit criterion for classical sheaves, Zariski locality, closure of classical sheaves under extensions, induction on the number of strata via the open-closed sequence, descent of constructibility, and (ii) by induction on the amplitude. Created 9 nodes: 3 unsplit (locally constant comparison Tag 099Y, pro-etale open-closed sequence Tag 09AH, local closedness of a stratum) and 6 Mathlib leaves for derived-category facts. To avoid the cycle through lem-weil-proetale-dbc-triangulated (whose Stacks proof, Tag 09B5/09AL, rests on 09AK), the statement no longer cites def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility: it names the sheaf node def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf and spells out the intrinsic bounded class; the proof never uses that the pro-etale class is triangulated. Added the missing stmt_deps (comparison morphism, coefficient ring, datum, cohomology sheaves).
